global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling golden noodles, topped with chashu, menma, and a soft-boiled egg, alongside dark greens. Served in a red-and-gold patterned bowl, it gleams under bright, even light against a neutral stainless steel backdrop.

regions.background: Metallic gray surface with subtle brushed texture and soft light reflections, curved edge visible.
regions.bowl: Red ceramic bowl with gold floral and scroll patterns, white rim, glossy surface, circular shape.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and gently swirling around pale yellow noodles with visible green spinach and brown bamboo shoots.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, pale brown meat with slightly glossy surface, irregularly shaped, showing soft texture and faint marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear light brown, slightly glossy, with irregular sliced shapes and visible fibrous texture.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, soft, round, with pink spiral swirl on top, slightly textured surface.
